Hero.subtitle: Discover an authentic neighborhood izakaya where premium ingredients, honest cooking, and heartfelt hospitality come together for an unforgettable experience. Fresh seafood, made-to-order dishes, and a welcoming atmosphere you will always want to return to.

Experience.title: Honest Cooking. Crafted with Precision.
Experience.subtitleHeading: Inspired by Japanese culinary precision and Korean warmth
Experience.paragraph1: At HAJUNG, every dish begins with deep respect for the ingredients, tradition, and the guests seated at our table. Inspired by Japanese culinary precision and Korean warmth, we believe the finest dining is born from exceptional ingredients prepared with genuine dedication.
Experience.paragraph2: Fresh seafood, seasonal produce, traditional techniques, and friendly service define every experience.
Experience.pillar1Desc: We carefully select every ingredient and prepare it fresh daily to preserve its full flavor, freshness, and quality.
Experience.pillar2Desc: We use Korean oak Binchotan charcoal to impart a delicate smoky aroma and crisp texture while highlighting the raw flavor of every ingredient.
Experience.pillar3Desc: From handcrafted ceramics to the final plating, every element is designed so you enjoy a truly memorable dining experience.

Gallery.title: A Place That Invites You to Stay
Gallery.subtitle: Explore our spaces, see the care behind every dish, and discover why HAJUNG has become one of Gwanak-gu's favorite neighborhood izakayas.

Story.title: Good Food. Sincere Hospitality.
Story.quote: “Good food doesn't need to be complicated. It just needs great ingredients, respect, and dedication.”
Story.desc1: HAJUNG was founded on a very simple idea: to offer exceptional food in a place where everyone feels genuinely welcome. Whether it's dinner with friends, a date night, or an after-work drink, you will always find thoughtful dishes, high-quality ingredients, and fair prices.
Story.val1: We meticulously select fresh seafood and premium products so every dish retains its authentic flavor.
Story.val2: Whether arriving solo, as a couple, or with a group, we want you to feel like a regular from your very first visit.
Story.val3: We believe a great dining experience shouldn't mean overpaying. Exceptional quality at honest prices.
Story.val4: We operate with professional culinary rigor paired with the warmth of a family welcoming guests home.

chef.title: Our Head Chef
chef.desc: Chef Koo Bonkwan personally prepares every cut of seafood with patience, precision, and deep respect for tradition. Every dish reflects years of expertise and culinary passion.

team.title: Our Dedicated Team
team.desc: Behind every service is a committed team working in harmony to deliver warm hospitality and meticulous care from kitchen to table.

ambience.title: Our Atmosphere
ambience.desc: Warm lighting, natural wood tones, and a relaxed ambiance make HAJUNG the perfect setting to share a great meal, celebrate, or simply unwind.

Location.title: We Look Forward to Welcoming You
